MeasureValue.title: MeasureValue
MeasureValue.description: One measure value: quantity (value+unit), cost (amount+currency), instant, or progress (0..1 fraction) — the W036 measure grammar, mirrored for the opaque-reference variance fold.

QuantityMeasure.title: QuantityMeasure
QuantityMeasure.description: A quantity measure value: canonical decimal value plus a unit-of-measure label (the W036 measure grammar).

NonNegativeDecimal.title: NonNegativeDecimal
NonNegativeDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal amount as a canonical string (digest-safe, no exponent form — the fixed-point discipline).

CostMeasure.title: CostMeasure
CostMeasure.description: A cost measure value: canonical decimal amount plus an ISO 4217 currency code (the W036 measure grammar).

InstantMeasure.title: InstantMeasure
InstantMeasure.description: An instant measure value: a point in time in the canonical UTC form (the W036 measure grammar).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

ProgressMeasure.title: ProgressMeasure
ProgressMeasure.description: A progress measure value: a completion fraction between 0 and 1 (the W036 measure grammar).
